heading: ESTABLISHMENT AND ADMINISTRATION OF GRANT PROGRAM

paragraphs: <ins>Sec. 64.052. ESTABLISHMENT AND ADMINISTRATION OF GRANT PROGRAM. The executive commissioner by rule shall establish and the commission shall administer a community health clinic grant program to increase access to health care, improve health outcomes, reduce health disparities, and achieve health equity in medically underserved areas of this state by:</ins>
<ins>(1) improving the provision of preventative care, screening, and treatment for chronic health conditions, including diabetes, hypertension, and obesity; and</ins>
<ins>(2) strengthening the availability and capacity of community health clinics to provide affordable, high-quality health care services to medically underserved individuals.</ins>
